items.html: Mark Watt drew attention to himself in no uncertain terms when he took three wickets at The Grange as Scotland overturned England, who were top of the worlds rankings at the time, in an ODI for the first time.

The spin bowler won opportunities with Lancashire later that summer, although he only took one wicket in four matches and missed out on Finals Day as a consequence.
ESPNcricinfo staff
